description:
List a company's counterparties (filter by ``kind``/``q``, paginated).

``kind`` repeats to filter on a set (``?kind=customer&kind=both``) — a
role-shaped picker asks for every kind that plays the role. A single
``?kind=supplier`` keeps its original meaning.

items.description:
Master-data axis of a counterparty (what the party primarily is).

``employee`` (payroll SP1, brief frozen decision 6) is set **only** on
counterparties auto-created by ``payroll.master_data
.ensure_employee_counterparty`` and is terminal — matching/merge flows never
widen it to ``both``. Subledger participation rides the richer
``gl_counterparty_role`` table; payroll logic never branches on ``kind``.

name: list_counterparties
